projects.title: Flutter UI Playground
projects.summary: A restricted Flutter and Dart learning environment with a custom widget-syntax parser, live rendering, lessons, project import, workspace tools, runner workflows and export support.
projects.overview: Flutter UI Playground is a safe, restricted Flutter widget-syntax environment built as a Flutter application. The repository is organized into app, core, shared and feature layers, with dedicated features for lessons, a playground, project import, workspace management, running code and exporting results. The playground itself separates configuration, controllers, syntax highlighting, models, parsing, rendering, screens and widgets. Its package uses the Dart analyzer alongside custom parsing/rendering infrastructure, Hive for local persistence, an embedded code editor/highlighter, archive support and HTTP. The goal is to let learners understand and experiment with Flutter UI structure without treating arbitrary source code as an unrestricted runtime.
features: Syntax highlighting and embedded code editing
Runner workflows for experimenting with code

challenges.title: Safe executable subset
challenges.description: The environment has to recognize and render a useful subset of Flutter-style widget syntax while keeping parsing and rendering under application control instead of executing arbitrary Dart source directly.

challenges.title: Learning and tooling in one workspace
challenges.description: Lessons, the editor, parsing, rendering, project import, running and export are split into feature modules so the learning workflow can grow without collapsing into one large screen.
